context: A chef and barista plan menus
purpose: Teach: むら/しづ/やめよ/資料館/遅かっ/カモ/ゴロ/栓

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、新作ケーキ、色むら、絶対出さんようにせなな。
lines.en: Aoi — make sure that new cake comes out without any color streaks, yeah?
lines.style: Warm, directive Kansai accent. Opens with her name like calling across the counter. Light, confident. Not bossy — team leader checking in on something that matters.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。バイトの、しづちゃん、明日からシフト入りますね。
lines.en: Got it. Shizu's starting her shifts tomorrow, right?
lines.style: Bright acknowledgment with a light upward lilt. Professional but genuinely interested. The kind of barista who actually registers when the roster changes.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 冷凍メニュー、もうやめようと思てる、こだわりたいんや。
lines.en: I've been thinking — we should drop the frozen stuff. I want us to care more about what we're making.
lines.style: Shift to earnest conviction. Slower pace, more weight on each word. Leans in slightly. This is about philosophy, not just logistics.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。地元の資料館とコラボ、企画していけそうですね。
lines.en: That could work. We could actually do something with the local museum — a real collaboration.
lines.style: Thoughtful, seeing the shape of something good. Quiet momentum building. She's thinking out loud with him, not just responding.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 食材の配達、遅かったな、今朝、悩みやで。
lines.en: The ingredient delivery was slow this morning, man. That's been on my mind.
lines.style: Slight frustration with an undertone of dark humor. Tired shrug in the voice. The kind of small thing that piles on during a morning rush.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。新メニューに、合鴨のカモ料理、加えませんか。
lines.en: What if we added roasted duck to the new menu? Would that work?
lines.style: Gentle probe — offering a solution, not pushing. Soft confidence. She's been listening, and now she's contributing to the shape of things.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 昼休み、ゴロ寝してる暇あらへんな、繁忙期は。
lines.en: There's no time for a lunch nap during busy season, is there? It all just keeps coming.
lines.style: Rueful acceptance mixed with dark humor. Quick cadence — matching the pace of the rush itself. A laugh underneath the complaint.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。新作のシードルの栓、明日、皆で抜きますね。
lines.en: Tomorrow we're opening that new cider together — all of us popping the cork.
lines.style: Warm closing note. Slight lift at the end — genuine anticipation. The kind of small shared moment that marks a shift. Inviting and inclusive.
